summary: Frontend-only testing of PhiCor.ai Patient Context + Quantity Calculator on /food. Searched 'Salmon', opened Quantity Calculator via data-testid='quantity-calculator-toggle'. Verified Base/Adjusted badges, +/- buttons (0.25 step), Reset button, and mini badge on the toggle. GlobalPatientPanel (Subject Profile) renders in the left sidebar with Bio/Medical/Diet/Intake tabs. No console/page errors observed during interaction.

ui_bugs.issue: Scaled Macronutrients preview grid (calories/protein/carbs/fat/fiber) does not appear when servingMultiplier !== 1. Code renders it only if scaledAnalysisResult?.scaledMacros exists, but scaledMacros appears to be undefined in the produced scaledAnalysisResult, so the section is never shown. Verified at 2x on Salmon.

Base value is inconsistent with Adjusted scaling. Base shows the food's original serving (e.g. '3 oz (85g)') but Adjusted at 2x shows '200g' (implying a 100g base). At 0.75x Adjusted shows '75g'. After Reset, Base flips to '100g'. Scaling math and Base label reference different values.
ui_bugs.selector: Base:/Adjusted: badges in Serving Size Calculator

action_items: Investigate why scaledAnalysisResult.scaledMacros is undefined so the Scaled Macronutrients preview grid renders when servingMultiplier != 1.
Reconcile Base badge value with the actual base used for scaling (either display '100g' consistently or scale from the food's originalServing e.g. 85g).
critical_code_review_comments: FoodAnalysisPage.js is 3155 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split into smaller modules (QuantityCalculatorPanel, MacroSummary, OrganEffectsGrid, etc.).
Quantity panel: Base badge relies on originalServing but adjusted math uses a different base -> unify source of truth for baseServingGrams.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Search flow: fill 'Search food...' input with 'Salmon' then press Enter (or click suggestion). Quantity toggle only renders after analysisResult loads. Use data-testid='quantity-calculator-toggle'. +/- buttons increment 0.25, Reset returns to 1x. Base/Adjusted badges update, but 'Scaled Macronutrients' preview grid never displays because scaledMacros is missing in scaledAnalysisResult - see FoodAnalysisPage.js lines 608-658 (useMemo) and 1718-1744 (render).
rca of the issue: Scaled Macros grid: conditional `scaledAnalysisResult?.scaledMacros && servingMultiplier !== 1` never true. Likely the useMemo in FoodAnalysisPage.js (lines 608-658) does not attach a `scaledMacros` object to the returned scaledAnalysisResult (field name mismatch or missing computation). Base/Adjusted inconsistency: Base badge uses `scaledAnalysisResult.originalServing` (from analysisResult.serving = '3 oz (85g)') while adjusted grams computed against a hardcoded/derived 100g base -> two different sources of truth.
